newsitem.title: UK: CCCI sets French franc/ecu December 2001 FRN.
newsitem.headline: CCCI sets French franc/ecu December 2001 FRN.

text.p: Caisse Centrale du Credit Immobilier de France (CCCI) has launched a two-tranche FRN, lead manager Credit Commerciale de France said.
Tranche one is for 3.0 billion French francs and tranche two is for 300 million ecu. They mature on December 10, 2001.

The Euro French franc issue pays three-month Pibor plus 1/16 percent and has an issue/reoffer price of 99.763. The ecu FRN pays 1/16 percent over three-month Libor with an issue/reoffer price of 99.835.

After the third stage of European and economic monetary union, provided France joins, any holder of the French franc notes will be able to exchange into the ecu notes on any payment date after January 1, 1999.
Morgan Stanley is joint lead manager on the French franc tranche and UBS is joint lead on the ecu tranche.
The lead managers have called the structure a "catamaran bond".
